name: Parallel Shear-Warp on Shared Memory
aliases: Real-time volume rendering on shared memory multiprocessors using the shear-warp factorization
definition: A parallel volume rendering algorithm for shared-memory multiprocessors that minimizes computation, synchronization, and data communication time.
summary: Parallel Shear-Warp on Shared Memory is a real-time volume rendering algorithm for shared-memory multiprocessors that minimizes communication by using image decomposition and memory transfers instead of network communication.
